name: execute_rizin_command
description: Execute one caller-selected Rizin command against a local artifact using the Rizin CLI profile that suppresses user settings and scripts while retaining plugins. Preserves decoded stdout and stderr inline with SHA-256 Evidence, up to a shared 16 MiB combined limit; invalid UTF-8 bytes are represented by replacement characters and flagged in Evidence limitations. output_truncated reports output beyond that limit and completion_status is unknown if buffer enforcement terminated the process. Rizin commands and retained plugins can execute foreign code, mutate files, access the network, and read files outside the selected artifact; identities and contents of those external inputs are not bound to Evidence. Command effects depend on the Rizin command and loaded plugins; JSON is command-specific and raw output remains authoritative. In a shared MCP server, this admitted command closes any active binary-analysis session; after its effects have settled, call open_binary before further analysis. Close an active Ghidra session explicitly first.

path.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.
